contract: 27 manually derived IEEE RNE finite BF16/F32 contraction cases, including distinct NONFUSED/FMA equations and a nondistinguishing underflow control; no model/source authority. Oracle authored independently; execution remains unclaimed.

cases.name: score_rn32_product_before_final_r16_counterexample
cases.derivation: Dot=129/128; alpha=(2^24-65027)/2^24. Exact product=257/256+125/2^31, less than half an F32 ulp above BF16 midpoint. RN32 gives 257/256, R16 ties to 1; direct real-to-BF16 would wrongly give 3f81.

cases.name: score_cast_before_scale_counterexample
cases.derivation: D32=257/256, first R16 ties to 1; alpha=129/128. Omitting first R16 gives 33153/32768, above midpoint 259/256, hence wrong 3f82.

cases.name: score_odd_midpoint_rounds_up
cases.derivation: 1+3/256=259/256 is midpoint; lower BF16 3f81 is odd.

cases.name: score_coordinate_order
cases.derivation: 2^25+1 rounds back to 2^25 before cancellation; cancellation before +1 retains 1.

cases.name: score_subnormal_half_ties_signed_zero
cases.derivation: +/-2^-133 times 1/2 yields +/-2^-134; R16 ties to signed zero.

cases.name: score_subnormal_normal_maxfinite
cases.derivation: Multiplication by 1 and accumulation from +0 are exact.

cases.name: score_f32_min_subnormal_alpha
cases.derivation: Exact +/-2^-149 RN32 product rounds to signed BF16 zero.

cases.name: score_first_bf16_cast_overflow_not_rescued
cases.derivation: D32=2^128-2^119 is finite F32, exactly BF16 overflow midpoint; first R16 must refuse before alpha=0.

cases.name: score_final_bf16_cast_overflow
cases.derivation: (2^128-2^120)*(1+2^-8)=2^128-2^112, finite F32 but above BF16 overflow midpoint.

cases.name: context_strided_no_renormalization
cases.derivation: Probabilities sum to 3/4. Row-major [[2,4],[4,8]] gives [2,4], NOT [8/3,16/3].

cases.name: context_underflow_nondistinguishing_fma_control
cases.derivation: Products 2^-134 and 2^-150. Separate second product RN32 ties to +0. Fused second add RN32(32768.5*2^-149) ties to even 32768*2^-149. Both finish R16(2^-134)=0000; useful underflow control, NOT an FMA discriminator.

cases.name: context_nonfused_vs_fma_three_term_witness
cases.derivation: Exact products 2^-134, 2^-149, -2^-150. NONFUSED last product RN32=-0, leaving 32769*2^-149, above BF16 midpoint, hence 0001. Fused last add RN32(32768.5*2^-149) ties to even 32768*2^-149, then BF16 midpoint ties to 0000. Independent Fraction equations assert both paths.

cases.name: context_signed_zero_accumulator
cases.derivation: D32 starts +0; neither +0+-0 nor +0++0 retains a negative zero.

cases.name: context_subnormal_half_ties_even
cases.derivation: Half of odd subnormal significands 1 and 3 ties to even 0 and 2; sign preserved.

cases.name: context_final_bf16_overflow
cases.derivation: Finite F32 sum at BF16 overflow midpoint 2^128-2^119.
